scope: Protection functions and model-vs-hardware verification; no component selection, ECO, solver run, or hardware qualification
working_power_interpretation: 1800 W is the Control Freak mains-input benchmark; no PMP efficiency is inherited and no DC-output requirement is asserted

requirements.must: Verify explicit F2 open during established run, startup, and charged/discharged/residual restart states; do not assume command equals energy removal
requirements.model: fault_checks requires F2 transition before detector event, prefault health, event timing, and retained-off observation; this is a modeled fault-opening witness, not proof of a controlled product disconnect
requirements.hardware: Measure F2 voltage/current and VD/VB energy separately; control signal is not isolation proof

requirements.must: Do not credit q/en/gate low as interruption for switch-short or both-short while current persists; define a gate-independent, F2-independent source-current interrupting path with clearing time, interrupted energy, safe-failure, and restart requirements in a later hardware study
requirements.model: switch-short/both-short channel current over frozen limit yields ProtectionGap in the post-detector slice rows[fault_idx..], beginning at the detector rising edge; source-fed and bank paths remain distinct
requirements.hardware: Measure VDS/VGS and line, inductor, F2, diode/body, channel currents; prove source interruption, stored-energy handling, clearing time, and survival; no part or existing trace proves this

requirements.must: Treat VD local capacitor and VB bank as separate reservoirs and verify F2-closed discharge loop
requirements.model: bank path Cbank→F2→VD→shorted terminal→MOS→node0; detector reports voltage conditions, not current allocation
requirements.hardware: Measure capacitor voltages, ESR/ESL, currents, and temperatures independently

requirements.must: Show detector coverage for each credited mode; qualify any negative ISENSE clamp
requirements.model: local BAV23C_ASSUMED_V2 clamp is an assumption; EVM no external clamp shown; TIDA D4 BAT54T1G network is not an automatic substitute
requirements.hardware: Characterize clamp Vf/leakage/dynamics/PCL and correlate detector timing with direct currents

requirements.must: Require fault, gate, latch, enable, rails, ARM and PERMIT requalification before restart
requirements.model: verify q/en/gate/fault/ARM/PERMIT/f2ctl/rails and reject rearm or unstable prefault
requirements.hardware: Exercise rail faults, ARM/PERMIT loss, standby, repeated mains and residual-energy restart

requirements.must: Requalify any graph containing reference D2 inrush bypass
requirements.model: local graph lacks D2; EVM/TIDA D2 can bypass inductor and MOS path; prior traces do not transfer
requirements.hardware: Verify D2 current/voltage, inrush, relay sequence, thermal stress and interruption

known_disposition.diode_short: FAIL timing window; passive-path and bank-discharge witnesses do not qualify physical survival
known_disposition.both_short: Screen failure prefix Lboost 435.79078242060086 A; protection not accepted
known_disposition.model_limits: fault_checks limits are frozen model screens, not hardware ratings
known_disposition.hardware_evidence_boundary: checker/hardware-validation-spec.md is an observation/comparison specification; later hardware evidence is needed and it does not authorize energization or establish acceptance
